lesson.summary:
Present perfect juga dipakai untuk pengalaman sepanjang hidup sampai sekarang. Kita tidak menyebut kapan persisnya: *Have you ever been to Raja Ampat? I've never eaten durian.* *ever* (pernah) dipakai di kalimat tanya, sedangkan *never* (tidak pernah) di kalimat positif yang bermakna negatif. Keduanya diletakkan sebelum V3.

Setelah bentuk superlatif, kita juga memakai present perfect: *It's the best rendang I've ever tasted.*

Bentuk ini juga dipakai untuk periode waktu yang belum selesai, seperti *today, this week, this month, this year, recently, so far*: *I've drunk three cups of coffee today. We haven't had much rain this month.* Kalau periodenya sudah selesai (*yesterday, last month*), pakai past simple.

Pola *It's the first time …* selalu diikuti present perfect: *It's the first time I've been on a plane.* Penutur Indonesia sering menulis *It's the first time I fly*, padahal bentuk yang benar memakai *have + V3*.

patterns.example: Have you ever climbed a mountain?

patterns.formula: It's the first time + subjek + have/has + V3
patterns.example: It's the first time I've driven a car.
It's the best film I've ever seen.

patterns.formula: have/has + V3 + today / this week / so far

examples.en: Have you ever been to Raja Ampat? – No, never, but I'd love to go.
examples.id: Kamu pernah ke Raja Ampat? – Belum, tapi saya ingin sekali.

examples.en: I've never eaten durian. I don't even want to try it.
examples.id: Saya belum pernah makan durian. Mencoba pun saya tidak mau.

examples.en: It's the first time I've been on a plane.
examples.id: Ini pertama kalinya saya naik pesawat.

examples.en: My father has drunk three cups of coffee today.
examples.id: Ayah saya sudah minum tiga cangkir kopi hari ini.

examples.en: It's the best rendang I've ever tasted.
examples.id: Ini rendang terenak yang pernah saya cicipi.

examples.en: I haven't seen Nina recently. Is she OK?
examples.id: Akhir-akhir ini saya tidak melihat Nina. Dia baik-baik saja?

commonMistakes.wrong: This is the first time I ride a horse.
commonMistakes.right: This is the first time I've ridden a horse.
commonMistakes.why: Pola *It's the first time …* memakai present perfect, bukan present simple.

commonMistakes.wrong: I never have been to Korea.
It's the most beautiful beach I ever saw.
commonMistakes.right: It's the most beautiful beach I've ever seen.
commonMistakes.why: Setelah superlatif, pakai present perfect: *I've ever seen*.
